title: 第15章 倾囊相授第16章 太乙炼瑕经
slug: 苟在仙宗打铁悄悄修成道祖
lines: 送走了执法堂的众人后，秦力明显想去找吴道说些什么，却被吴道以恢复伤势为由制止。
直到次日晚上，吴道才将秦力叫到屋中叙话。
李牧火躺在床上偷听，哪怕吴道设置了隔音阵法，但本身实力有限，自然瞒不过李牧火有心偷听。
屋内。
秦力一脸担忧道：“师父，精铁矿一事为何不顺势告诉执法堂的人？”
吴道沉着气道：“莫急。非是为师不愿告诉执法堂的人，而是你我此刻不该知道此事。否则对方若问你我何时知晓，为何知而不报，你我该如何解释？况且，外门物资堂必有炼魔宗奸细，否则一年前便不会驳回为师申请转移炼器坊的请求，现在想来，那时的驳回，应该便是为了今日之事在做准备。只是对方千算万算，没算到会有个神秘高人横插一脚。”
秦力闻言，越发犯愁：“可总不能一直这么下去吧？只要精铁矿在，对方只怕不会罢手的。”
吴道眯着眼睛，沉默许久才道：“放心，为师自然不会一直瞒下去。那个张主事不是说会安排外门弟子前来驻守么？待时机合适，为师自会引导他们去发现精铁矿，届时执法堂应该就不会再限制我等去留了。”
只是，话虽这么说，但吴道眼底的忧色并未散去，在长久的无声后，吴道忽然开口道：“不论此事后续如何，青竹炼器坊都不能再待了。能让炼魔宗出动这么多高手，山里的事绝非精铁矿那么简单。想要不受牵连，只有离开。再有一年，牧火几人入坊便有五年了，按照玄天宗的规矩，五年便可申请调离，届时为师会先设法将他们送走。你和开山这边，为师也会托昔日友人，设法将你们调去外门炼器堂进修……”
藏在暗处偷听的李牧火，闻言也是心头一震，吴道的确是一位好师父，是真的将他们当做弟子看待的。
“师父，那你呢？”
秦力双眼通红，将门下弟子都送走，那吴道自己又该何去何从？
然而，吴道却淡淡一笑：“为师年事已高，前日一战更是伤及根本，怕是活不了几年了。明年待你们都离开后，为师自会向宗门请辞，返回俗世，想来宗门不会拒绝。唉！想我寻仙半生，一事无成，家中亲人也不知还在不在了。”
说到此处，吴道也不再多说，似是陷入了回忆，只是摆了摆手，示意秦力离开。
然而，秦力却并未离开，反而沉默了数息后再次开口：“师父，届时我和你一起返回俗世。”
“胡闹，你正直壮年，还有冲击筑基境的可能，随我去凡俗作甚？”
吴道愕然回神，当即骂道。
然而，秦力的脸上却露出一丝向往的笑容：“师父，冲击筑基境是很难的。以前常听三儿说凡俗多欢乐，我有时也会想，与其在这外门炼器坊耕耘一生，何不回去人世间再体验一遭。毕竟，弟子不是小师弟，没那么喜欢炼器的。”
“唉！你可想清楚了？”
吴道长叹一声，但并未再劝阻。
秦力认真地点了点头：“其实在得知三儿死的那一刻我就想清楚了，我知道他一直都想回俗世看看。而今他死了，我想替他去看看。”
“也罢！也罢！”
吴道再次挥了挥手，没再说话。
秦力回屋后，李牧火躺在床上，心中也颇为感慨。
感慨了一阵，李牧火忽然心头一动，想起自己还藏了好几个储物袋，便拿出来翻看。
其中，除了灵石，丹药，基础符箓，法器飞剑和一些日用之物，最让李牧火心喜的是，其中一个储物袋里存放着大量精铁，甚至还有数千斤可用于炼制法器的铁精，这让他心中激荡不已。
可惜，这些物资暂时不能拿出来用，否则难以解释。
除此之外，他还收获了几本魔道功法，比如《炼皮术》、《幻音法》、《魔灵步》和一些诸如《血炼功》、《炼尸诀》等一看就是邪功的功法。
这些功法李牧火自然是不会修炼的，他一个打铁的，又不准备当魔头，练这些作甚？
于是，李牧火又将这些储物袋给藏了起来，短时间内不会考虑去动用。
次日早。
李牧火一如往常，起床和林越练刀。
林越的刀法，圆融一体，好像又有所突破。
“吃饭啦！”
钱朵朵的声音从膳房传来，没了三师兄，钱朵朵便主动承担起膳房的职责，只是脸上没有了往日般天真的笑容，眸中似乎多了一份坚毅。
至于陈功，他愈发沉默了，整个吃饭的过程中，一言不发，似乎也受到了刺激。
看来，三师兄失踪这件事，给所有人都带来了不小的冲击。
说是失踪，其实大家都知道，大概率是陨落了，连尸骨都未必能留下。
饭后。
吴道语气平静地说道：“牧火，随我进炼器房。”
content_en:
After sending everyone away from the Law Enforcement Hall, Qin Li obviously wanted to go to Wu Dao to say something, but Wu Dao stopped him on the grounds of recovering from his injuries.
It wasn't until the next night that Wu Dao called Qin Li into the house to talk.
Li Muhuo lay on the bed and eavesdropped. Even though Wu Dao had set up a soundproof formation, his own strength was limited and he could not hide Li Muhuo's intention to eavesdrop.
inside the house.
Qin Li said with a worried look on his face: "Master, why don't you tell the people at the Law Enforcement Hall about the iron ore?"
Wu Dao said calmly: "Don't be anxious. It's not that I don't want to tell the people in the Law Enforcement Hall, but that you and I shouldn't know about this at this moment. Otherwise, if the other party asks you when I knew about it and why I didn't report it, how should you and I explain it? Besides, there must be someone refining the demon in the Outer Gate Materials Hall. Zong's spy, otherwise he would not have rejected the request to transfer the weapon refinery as a master a year ago. Now that I think about it, the rejection at that time should be in preparation for today's matter. It's just that the other party did not expect that a mysterious master would intervene. "
When Qin Li heard this, he became more and more worried: "But we can't keep going like this, right? As long as the iron ore is there, I'm afraid the other party won't give up."
Wu Dao squinted his eyes and was silent for a long time before saying: "Don't worry, I won't keep it a secret forever. Didn't Director Zhang say that he would arrange for the outer disciples to come and garrison? When the time is right, I will guide them to discover the iron ore, and then the Law Enforcement Hall will no longer restrict us from staying."
However, having said that, the worry in Wu Dao's eyes did not dissipate. After a long period of silence, Wu Dao suddenly said: "No matter what happens next, we can't stay in Qingzhu Refining Workshop any longer. If the Demon Refining Sect can dispatch so many masters, things in the mountains are by no means as simple as concentrated iron ore. If you don't want to be immune to it, If you are implicated, you have to leave. In one year, it will be five years since Mu Huo and others have been here. According to Xuantian Sect's rules, you can apply for transfer after five years. At that time, I will try to send them away first. I will also ask your former friends to try to transfer you to the Outer Sect Weapon Refining Hall for further training..."
Li Muhuo, who was hiding in the dark and eavesdropping, was shocked when he heard this. Wu Dao was indeed a good master and he really treated them as his disciples.
"Master, what about you?"
Qin Li's eyes turned red and he sent all his disciples away. Then where should Wu Dao himself go?
However, Wu Dao smiled faintly: "My master is already old, and the battle the day before yesterday damaged my roots. I'm afraid I won't live for a few more years. After you all leave next year, I will resign from the sect and return to the world. I don't think the sect will refuse. Alas! I have been searching for immortals for half my life, but I have achieved nothing. I don't know if my relatives at home are still there."
At this point, Wu Dao didn't say much more, as if he was lost in memories, and just waved his hand, signaling Qin Li to leave.
However, Qin Li did not leave. Instead, he was silent for a few breaths and then spoke again: "Master, I will return to the earthly world with you."
"Nonsense, you are still in your prime, and you still have the possibility of reaching the foundation-building realm. What are you going to do with me in the ordinary world?"
Wu Dao came to his senses in shock and immediately cursed.
However, a longing smile appeared on Qin Li's face: "Master, it is difficult to break through to the foundation-building realm. I used to hear San'er say that the ordinary world is full of joy. Sometimes I also think that instead of working all my life in this outer sect's weapon refining workshop, why not go back to the human world and experience it again. After all, I am not a junior disciple, and I don't like weapon refining that much."
"Oh! Have you thought clearly?"
Wu Dao sighed, but did not dissuade him any more.
Qin Li nodded seriously: "Actually, I thought clearly the moment I learned about San'er's death. I know that he always wanted to go back to the world to see. Now that he is dead, I want to go and see for him."
"Whatever! Whatever!"
Wu Dao waved his hand again and said nothing.
After Qin Li returned to the house, Li Muhuo was lying on the bed, feeling quite emotional.
After sighing for a while, Li Muhuo suddenly felt something in his heart. He remembered that he had hidden several storage bags, so he took them out and looked through them.
Among them, in addition to spiritual stones, elixirs, basic talismans, magic weapons and flying swords, and some daily necessities, what pleased Li Muhuo the most was that one of the storage bags contained a large amount of refined iron, and there were even thousands of kilograms of iron essence that could be used to refine magic weapons, which made him excited.
Unfortunately, these supplies cannot be used for the time being, otherwise it would be difficult to explain.
In addition, he also obtained several magic techniques, such as "Skin Alchemy", "Phantom Sound Technique", "Demon Spirit Steps" and some techniques such as "Blood Alchemy", "Corpse Refining Technique" and other techniques that are obviously evil at first glance.
Naturally, Li Muhuo doesn't know how to practice these techniques. He is a blacksmith and he is not ready to become a devil. Why do he practice these techniques?
Therefore, Li Muhuo hid these storage bags again and would not consider using them in the short term.
Early next day.
Li Muhuo got up and practiced swordplay with Lin Yue as usual.
Lin Yue's sword skills were integrated and seemed to have made another breakthrough.
"It's time to eat!"
Qian Duoduo's voice came from the dining room. Without the third senior brother, Qian Duoduo took the initiative to take on the responsibility of the dining room, but his face no longer had the innocent smile of the past, and there seemed to be more perseverance in his eyes.
As for Chen Gong, he became more and more silent. He didn't say a word during the whole meal, and he seemed to be stimulated.
It seems that the disappearance of the third senior brother has brought a big shock to everyone.
Although they say they are missing, in fact everyone knows that they most likely died, and even their bones may not be left behind.
After meal.
Wu Dao said calmly: "Mu Huo, follow me into the refining room."
